entities.name: Elongation factor Tu
observations: Query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A0M3Z6 from Christiangramia forsetii; 395 residues.
EF-Tu is a GTP hydrolase that promotes GTP-dependent delivery of aminoacyl-tRNA to the ribosomal A site during translation elongation.
Reviewed reference annotation identifies cytoplasmic localization, monomeric state, GTPase activity, GTP binding, and magnesium-ion binding.

entities.name: GTP hydrolysis
observations: Annotated reaction: GTP + H2O = GDP + phosphate + H(+); Rhea RHEA:19669, EC 3.6.5.3.

entities.name: Translation elongation
observations: EF-Tu facilitates GTP-dependent binding of aminoacyl-tRNA to the ribosomal A site during protein biosynthesis.
